author: Joel
date: Uncertain (suggestions range from the 800s to the 400s BC)
overview: A devastating plague of locusts becomes a warning of "the day of the Lord". Joel calls the people to return to God with their whole heart. God promises to restore what the locusts ate and to pour out his Spirit on all people, a promise Peter quotes in Acts 2.
storyPlace: One of the twelve shorter prophetic books known as the Minor Prophets ("minor" because they are short, not less important).
